verdict.rationale: Mailchimp says its e-commerce tracking (e.g., via the Magento integration) measures campaign ROI. It also says Analytics AI explains which campaigns and automations are moving revenue, and it markets insights into audience growth and conversion funnels. This covers revenue attribution to emails and flows, but it depends on a commerce integration, and the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on attribution models and windows, attribution of non-commerce signups to specific emails or flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
